name: Gemini
billing: Some models have limited free quotas. Paid API usage requires the project’s current billing setup; check AI Studio before sending a request.
steps: Sign in to Google AI Studio and accept the applicable terms. Select or import the Google Cloud project you intend to use.
Open API keys and create an auth key for that project. Use the current key type and restrictions described by Google’s key guide.
Check the project’s API quotas, model availability and billing. Store the key only in your local application environment.
